frontier.hypothesis: A class grant covering /* FAKE */-annotated loop-carried counting carriers would close this function immediately - the closing body is already written and already measured at distance 0 (s6).
frontier.mechanism: count_loop_regs_set takes insn_count before move_movables and before strength_reduce, so a loop-carried constant-step biv is COUNTED and then deleted by biv elimination inside loop_optimize for zero emitted bytes; 32 balanced pairs take the loop 56 -> 121 real insns byte-identically and flip the 0x91A2B3C5 movable to not-desirable at >= 120. s10 confirms the target arithmetic term by term: savings and lifetime are both pinned at 1, so only insn_count can move.
frontier.next_probe: None from inside a grind session - this is an owner-only extension of the frozen family list. If it ever lands, restore memory/grind/func_8003C714/rejected/balanced-biv-noise-64-insns-d0-but-inadmissible.c, re-measure, and add the FAKE annotation.

frontier.hypothesis: A toolchain finding that changes n_non_fixed_regs on the shipped chassis without a CC_FLAGS edit (evidence that the original build's cc1 was configured for a no-FPU target, making -msoft-float chassis FIDELITY rather than a chassis change) would let the honest candidate.c body match as-is.
frontier.mechanism: loop.c:532 threshold = 2*(1+n_non_fixed_regs) is 122 with FP regs free and 58 with them fixed; after one threshold -= 3 the magic faces 55 against insn_count 56 and stays in-loop in the target's split lui/ori form. s10's reading of loop.c:597/791/793 shows this is the only remaining free term, since savings and lifetime are both structurally 1.
frontier.next_probe: None from inside a grind session (barred by this function's binding judge constraint and by .claude/rules/no-compiler-divergence.md). Any such finding must also resolve the s2 conflict where the same configuration regresses func_800324D0 from 0 to 3.

frontier.hypothesis: A hoisted invariant whose preheader insn is deleted AFTER loop_optimize would make the movable-slot dial byte-free, and s10 measured the dial closes the gap by 5 per slot, so about 12 such invariants would decline the 0x91A2B3C5 movable at zero byte cost.
frontier.mechanism: move_movables emits each moved invariant into the preheader and decrements threshold by 3 (loop.c:1719/1904) while its in-loop set also raised insn_count. If the preheader insn's only consumer is removed later inside loop_optimize (strength reduction / biv elimination) or by cse2 as redundant with an existing preheader value, flow deletes it and the slot is free.
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate invariants whose sole in-loop consumer is deleted by strength_reduce, and check whether any is NOT already covered by s7's K22 (which measured that a hoistable step constant makes the biv increment a register and disqualifies biv elimination at ~9 emitted instructions). If K22 does not cover the case where the invariant feeds a giv ADDRESS rather than a biv step, measure that shape - the s10 four-movable dump shows givs at insns 52/66/97/137 all combining, which is where such an invariant would land.
